candidate_windows.window_text: We use PyTorch (Paszke et al., 2019) for all our implementations. All our models were trained from scratch, and the parameters were updated using Adam optimizer. We designed a compositional validation set by taking few examples from each compositional splits of the respective dataset. The best model is selected based on the accuracy on this compositional validation set. Hyperparameter tuning was done using grid search. We show the best hyperparameters for our models corresponding to different datasets in Table 10. Moreover, we show the average performance of 3 different runs with random seeds for all the models in the paper. We used 8 NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPUs each with 32 GB memory for all our experiments.
